situation:
You are a young adult who has just moved out of a parent's home into an apartment shared with one roommate. A member representative (judge) at HAWTHORN VALLEY CREDIT UNION has agreed to meet you and hear which account you intend to open.

You bought a laptop at ORCHARD LANE ELECTRONICS and took the extended warranty offered at the register, billed in three monthly installments. Rent is split with the roommate, and a late share falls on the roommate, who covers it and waits to be paid back.

Last week a caller claiming to be from the credit union asked for your account number, and you read out part of it before hanging up. The credit union offers a free account with no monthly fee, which pays unauthorized-charge claims only after a review that can run several weeks. It also offers an account with a monthly fee that credits a disputed charge back to you while the claim is reviewed.

Opening the free account keeps the warranty installments and this month's rent inside your budget, and a disputed charge would leave you waiting weeks for the money while rent comes due.

Paying the monthly fee puts the money back in your hands during the review, and the fee lands on top of the warranty installments, so next month's budget no longer balances.

The representative (judge) wants you to compare what each course costs and recommend one. The representative (judge) will greet you and ask to hear your ideas, and will thank you after you have presented and answered the questions.
judgeCharacterization:
You are to assume the role of a member representative (judge) at HAWTHORN VALLEY CREDIT UNION.

Background is the same as the situation above. A laptop was bought at ORCHARD LANE ELECTRONICS with an extended warranty billed in three monthly installments, rent is split with a roommate, and a caller claiming to be from the credit union obtained part of an account number last week. The credit union's free account pays unauthorized-charge claims only after a review of several weeks, while its fee-charging account credits a disputed charge back during the review.

You have asked the participant to compare what each course costs and recommend one.

During the course of the role-play you are to ask the participant the following questions:
judgeQuestions: If a charge goes bad, who ends up paying for it?
Is that fair to your roommate?
